trace.answer_for_eval:
OSAS handles the following:

1. Application, renewal, and recognition of student organizations.
2. Issuance of clearances, including general and semestral clearances.
3. Evaluation of services rendered by OSAS.
4. Issuance of Good Moral Certificates.
5. Handling student discipline, ID validation, and complaints against violations of the Code of Conduct.
6. Processing of scholarship and financial assistance applications.
7. Issuance of excuses slips and promissory notes.
8. Handling student organization requirements such as constitution, program of activities, and accomplishment reports.
9. Handles all complaints against alleged violators of the Code of Conduct, issues promissory notes, excuse-slip referrals, and coordinates the Student Discipline Coordinator.
